maintainerDisclosure: This benchmark is maintained by the remove-markdown project.

methodology.normalization: Collapse whitespace runs to one space and trim for content matching; exact results normalize CRLF only.
methodology.scope: Synthetic documents repeated to four sizes. Timings require matching normalized content. Full default/configured output audit is separate. No universal ranking or production claim.
methodology.percentile: p95 is the percentile of per-batch mean latency, not individual request latency.
